newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian forint ends easier vs dlr at 191.83/88.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian forint ends easier vs dlr at 191.83/88.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed easier against the dollar the afternoon session of the inter-bank forex market on Monday and the day's losses were due to a weakening of the German mark, dealers said.
The forint closed at 191.83/88 against the U.S. unit compared with an opening of 190.75/80 and 191.80/85 at midday.
The Hungarian unit floats against the central bank's currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
Dealers said the forint firmed some 20 fillers early in the afternoon but it continued to move downwards following the dollar/mark.
The Hungarian unit remained right on the National Bank of Hungary resistance level (bid) throughout the session.
The NBH's floating intervention band is 4.5 percent wide.
